recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-34153 unless a future final Jira decision reopens modal-verb wording elsewhere in ValueSet.
issue_request: FHIR-34153 was a Published/Persuasive R5 vocab change request asking whether SHALL and MUST differed in ValueSet.expansion.contains generated tables, with a resolution to change two remaining "Must" occurrences for the constraints to "SHALL".
initial_application: Commit b77b742253cb7f301ec7dc2eb3c42199e3ef331c, "Resolved several text only vocabulary changes", explicitly included "FHIR-34153 Update must to SHALL for value set constraints" and changed the vsd-9 and vsd-10 human messages in source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml from Must to SHALL.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ValueSet as an active resource and maps ValueSet constraints to the vsd prefix. The current ValueSet source has vsd-9 and vsd-10 using SHALL. Vocab Confluence agenda/minutes referenced FHIR-34153 as a ValueSet ticket, while Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. A later Jira search surfaced FHIR-55638 about MUST/SHALL wording in ValueSet.$expand, but it is Submitted and concerns different operation text.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active authoritative StructureDefinition source already reflects the requested modal-verb cleanup, and no remaining old vsd-9/vsd-10 Must strings were found in source or release history files checked.
